summary: @servicetitan/intl preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle unrelated to intl
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXX` identifiers and inline dictionary lookups that conceal an `https.get` download of the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extraction into a tempdir, `chmod +x`, and `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. The invoked sibling `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string-array deobfuscator and hex-encoded identifiers, unreadable from source. The package's advertised purpose is intl/i18n; neither downloading a separate language runtime at install time nor executing a large opaque bundle named `math_init.js` matches that purpose. The alternate-runtime step also runs the payload outside the Node-resolved code path, evading Node-only inspection. Execution fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
